temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. Maria offers help, and Cheryl accepts, saying it would be amazing and that she could definitely use the help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria had no specific prior belief about Cheryl being overwhelmed by this project or needing help with it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Maria learns that Cheryl is stressed and overwhelmed, and that Cheryl welcomes Maria's offer of assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is currently overwhelmed by the outreach project and would benefit from Maria's help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and willing to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria observes Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing in confidence. During a staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next project phase. The team leader approves, and Cheryl thanks Maria for her confidence, saying she is ready for the challenge.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has improved in handling responsibilities, is gaining confidence, and has shown aptitude and commitment.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Maria's positive view is confirmed; her suggestion is accepted, and Cheryl states she is ready for the leadership role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, ready, and willing to lead the next phase of the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl as she takes on the leadership role.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria privately approaches Cheryl to make sure she felt supported and not pressured. Cheryl says she was a bit surprised but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl accepted the leadership role, but she worries that Cheryl might perceive Maria's suggestion as overstepping or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Maria's worry is resolved because Cheryl reassures her that she appreciates the support and belief.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl values Maria's support and belief and does not feel pressured or resentful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To ensure Cheryl continues to feel supported and to maintain open, respectful communication.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes that she and Cheryl co-lead the project together. Cheryl calls it a fantastic idea, says Maria's guidance has been invaluable, and agrees they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl valued her honesty and support, and Maria feels relieved that there are no hard feelings.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Cheryl welcomes the co-leading idea and values Maria's guidance, confirming that they can collaborate closely and support each other.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Co-leading the project with Cheryl is mutually agreeable, and they can work effectively as a team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and support each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Maria joyfully asks about teaming up for more projects in the future, and Cheryl enthusiastically agrees, calling their work together wonderful and saying she is excited about what they can achieve.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership has grown strong, and she feels joyful about their synergy.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Cheryl's enthusiastic agreement confirms that she wants to continue collaborating on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl have a strong partnership and will team up for more projects in the future.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl for more future projects.
